g.text: Sales-to-production intelligence layer: architecture and APIs
The model reads language. The engine computes dates, quantities and prices. A person approves anything that reaches a customer or production.
decisions · actions · suggestions · mail ledger · CRM readings
stand-ins · standins.jar, one process per profile · systems of record
- Arrows are calls: HTTP between processes, in-process inside core.
- Violet: language read by the model (mail, questions, CRM notes). The core checks every value.
- Green: the engine computes every date, quantity, price and probability.
- Yellow: nothing reaches a customer or production without a recorded person or pre-approved rule.
- If the model is down: mail waits unread, questions say "cannot read", nothing is guessed.
